claim: the published IMAD-DS official baseline reproduces
basis: all six comparisons NEAR_EXACT, worst 0.33 of a pre-frozen 0.5 band; tolerance committed 58 minutes before the first score and unchanged since

claim: the differences are of the size expected from a nondeterministic training run
basis: one run per machine, so no variance was measured; and the reproduction ran on CPU, where the cited cuDNN nondeterminism does not apply. The dominant driver of the gap is a different execution environment (device, backend, torch version) interacting with patience-3 stopping, not nondeterminism within this run
action: reword to 'consistent with plausible run-to-run variation under the upstream nondeterministic implementation'

claim: this makes MechaSight's own results comparable to the literature
basis: what was validated is the Protocol-A path only. Protocol B uses different preprocessing, a different representation (98 engineered features), different models and a parent-disjoint split. None of that is exercised here
action: narrow to: establishes a comparability anchor for Protocol-A-style numbers, and validates this project's dataset handling and official-split evaluation

claim: recording overlap creates a credible mechanism for optimistic bias; the magnitude is to be measured
basis: independently recomputed: 62/101 parents cross the split and the overlap is asymmetric - 212/232 normal test segments have a training sibling versus 0/232 anomaly. Correctly hedged; no magnitude asserted

claim: Protocol A minus Protocol B is not a leakage estimate
basis: scanned every Phase-3.3 artifact; no such arithmetic and no forbidden phrasing appears. The two protocols differ in split, preprocessing, representation and model family simultaneously

claim: CPU use is authorised by upstream
basis: the upstream notebook comment explicitly instructs adapting the device. That authorises the substitution but does not make it a bitwise-equivalent execution environment, and the report should not be read as claiming it does
action: keep, and state the substitution/equivalence distinction explicitly

basis: true of the seven logged reproduction discrepancies, each verified. But the per-segment scores were never persisted, so the headline metrics are not independently re-derivable from artifacts - an open auditability gap
action: record the score-persistence gap as an unresolved item

claim: BrushlessMotor 58.98 is benchmark discrimination on the released cohort, not mechanical-fault sensitivity
basis: the confound disclosure is carried in the report, the config, and every one of the 42 primary_auc.csv rows via scientific_limitation_id

claim: the upstream best-checkpoint aliasing means the final epoch was scored
basis: PyTorch aliasing verified empirically on a toy model: state_dict returns live references, later optimizer steps mutate them, BatchNorm running stats included. The reproduction deliberately performs no restore

claim: the project's data path, windowing, feature construction, model and scoring are consistent with the published work
basis: Protocol A uses per-window standardised raw multi-sensor input, not the Phase-3.1 98-feature representation. 'feature construction' implies the engineered feature pipeline was validated; it was not
